about: PROPOSED for the kit (03_Master_Data\FMC_Roles.json, beside the FMC_Rulebook folder), owner 26 Oct 2026. Role playbooks: what each role does, who reviews it, and the checklist per stage. People and AI agents use the same playbooks; an agent never takes a role ranked above the person it assists. Checklist items point at rule IDs in the kit's rulebooks (written once, used by every role); an item whose rules are script-checked passes from the latest QA run, the others need a person's tick. Only the Modeller design-stage list is filled in (pilot); the BIM Manager approves the rest through the kit change process.

Modeller.duties: Models to the brief and the kit: kit families and types, named views and levels, clean warnings, nothing imported or in-place without a reason.

design.title: Model file named to the standard
Levels and views named to the standard
No default or uncoded type names
No CAD imports or in-place families without a reason
Model checked against the brief (spaces, areas, client requirements)
WIP to Shared checklist done before sharing

QS.duties: Quantities and costs from the model and the kit's master data; flags uncoded or unmeasurable elements.

BIM Coordinator.duties: Reviews modellers' work, coordinates links, runs QA, prepares sharing.

BIM Manager.duties: Owns standards, the kit, roles and permissions; approves gates.
